Windows raw cursor uses GetThreadContext + StackWalk64. Cursor iteration can repeat initial IP, and termination alone does not distinguish a normal root from unwind failure.

Process-owned thread handles are enumerated under the lock; independent fixture native TID/creation/time/cycle handles and native seqlock bracket the whole read.
